_doc: GENERATED by tools/build-hero-skills.mjs from prototypes/farhold/data/skills.json (skill rows) + the HEROES/DESC tables in that tool. Do not edit by hand: change the tool and re-run it. Hero dps/hp curves live in econ.json (hero + classes). Read by js/sim/heroes.js, skills.js, talents.js, statuses.js.

ranks._doc: Basic skills (Q W E D) have 3 ranks; rank r needs hero level 2r-1. The ultimate (R) has 3 ranks at levels 6/11/16. Each rank past the first: mult x (1 + multPerRank), cooldown x (1 - cdPerRank).

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.desc: Melee bruiser. Holds a crowd in place and cuts it down.

choices.name: Reaping Arc
choices.desc: Cleave becomes a wide 220° sweep reaching 5.5 m that knocks enemies back 1.5 m.

choices.name: Hooked Edge
choices.desc: Cleave drags everything it hits 2 m toward you.

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
pyromancer.desc: Ranged caster. Stacks Burning on crowds and sets them off.

choices.name: Cinder Spray
choices.desc: Firebolt throws three bolts in a fan, each for 65% of the damage.

choices.name: Slow Burner
choices.desc: Firebolt leaves a 2 m patch of fire for 3 s where it lands.

ranger.name: Ranger

passive.name: Quarry
passive.desc: Every 4th basic attack marks the target as Quarry: it takes 20% more damage for 6 s.

ranger.desc: Ranged marksman. Marks Quarry, snares the road and rains arrows on it.

choices.name: Wide Fan
choices.desc: Broadhead Fan looses 7 arrows in a wider fan, each for 80% of the damage.

choices.name: Tight Fan
choices.desc: Broadhead Fan looses 3 arrows straight ahead, each for 130% of the damage.

druid.name: Druid
druid.desc: Shapeshifter. Roots and heals at range; becomes a thorned boar that holds the line or a wolf that hunts; calls wolves.

choices.name: Thorn Fan
choices.desc: Thornlash throws three lashes in a fan; Bramble Gore sweeps a wider arc.

choices.name: Barbed
choices.desc: Thornlash also leaves the target Bleeding.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.desc: Builder. Holds a lane with turrets (one, then two, then three), mines the road and overcharges the guns.

choices.name: Heavy Bolts
choices.desc: Bolt Turrets hit 40% harder but fire a little slower.

choices.name: Scrap Plating
choices.desc: Bolt Turrets have 60% more health and stand 15 s longer.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Strike everything within 4.5 m for 29% weapon damage, +12% for each enemy hit past the first (up to +48%).

breaching_shove.name: Breaching Shove
breaching_shove.desc: Strike an 80° arc 3 m ahead for 28% weapon damage, knock targets back 4 m and stun them for 0.6 s.

warcry.name: War Cry
warcry.desc: Gain Might (+30% damage for 12 s). Enemies within 10 m attack you for 3 s; each one adds 5% to Might (up to +25%).

iron_resolve.name: Iron Resolve
iron_resolve.desc: For 10 s take 6% less damage per enemy within 6 m (up to 36%); every 4th hit you take releases a 4 m shockwave for 20% weapon damage.

whirlwind.name: Iron Gyre
whirlwind.desc: Spin 5 times over 1.6 s, striking everything within 5.5 m for 20% weapon damage each spin, pulling it in and leaving it Bleeding. You move 30% slower while spinning.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.desc: Hurl a bolt up to 18 m for 65% weapon damage that splashes 2.6 m and adds a stack of Burning (9% weapon damage a second per stack, up to 5).

fire_wall.name: Burning Line
fire_wall.desc: Raise a 10 m line of flame up to 15 m away across your aim: 43% weapon damage and 2 Burning stacks to everything in it, then it burns for 5 s (6% weapon damage a second).

flashover.name: Flashover
flashover.desc: Ignite a 6 m area up to 15 m away for 47% weapon damage and set off Burning: 60% of each target's remaining burn damage at once (one stack stays).

ember_stride.name: Cinder Stride
ember_stride.desc: For 8 s move 20% faster and leave burning ground behind you (11% weapon damage a second); the spot you start from burns for 4 s (15% a second).

meteor.name: Fallstone
meteor.desc: Call a stone down on an 8 m area up to 18 m away after a short delay: 125% weapon damage and 3 Burning stacks.

aimed_shot.name: Long Draw
aimed_shot.desc: Loose a heavy arrow up to 21 m for 76% weapon damage that ignores half of the target's resistance; more damage the further it flies (up to +60%).

hunters_snare.name: Hunter's Snare
hunters_snare.desc: Set a snare up to 10 m away (two at most). It arms after 1 s; the first enemy to step on it roots everything within 2.5 m, deals 32% weapon damage and marks them as Quarry.

multi_shot.name: Broadhead Fan
multi_shot.desc: Fire 5 arrows in a fan for 20% weapon damage each. An arrow that hits Quarry splits into 2 shards.

trackers_leap.name: Tracker's Leap
trackers_leap.desc: Leap 4.5 m back from where you aim, striking everything within 2.5 m of where you stood for 52% weapon damage. Your next basic attack within 3 s deals 50% more.

rain_of_arrows.name: Arrow Storm
rain_of_arrows.desc: Rain 8 volleys over 4 s on a 6.5 m area up to 16 m away, 10% weapon damage each; Quarry takes 50% more and loses the mark.

thornlash.name: Thornlash
thornlash.desc: Lash a target up to 15 m away for 56% weapon damage and root it for 0.6 s (not again on the same target for 6 s); your wolves heal 3%. In Briarback: Bramble Gore, a wide gore that knocks back and taunts what it hits. As a Wolf: Throat Leap, a pounce up to 7 m that bites and leaves the target Bleeding.

renew.name: Greensap
renew.desc: Mending for 10 s (2.5% of your health a second). In Briarback: Thornswell, a barrier of 20% of your health for 6 s that returns 20% of the damage it takes. As a Wolf: Rending Bite, a bite that adds 2 Bleeding stacks.

wolf_shape.name: Wolf Shape
wolf_shape.desc: Take the Wolf shape (or leave it): 25% faster, 30% quicker bites, +10% health, and your other skills become wolf abilities: Throat Leap, Rending Bite, Pack Run and Running Howl.

briarback_shape.name: Briarback Shape
briarback_shape.desc: Take the Briarback shape (or leave it): +60% armour, +30% health, attackers take 15% of their blow back, and your attacks gore everything in front of you. Taking it taunts enemies within 6 m. As a Wolf: Pack Run, 35% faster for 5 s.

call_wolf.name: Call the Pack
call_wolf.desc: Call two Grove Wolves to fight beside you (at most two) and howl: you and your wolves are Hastened and deal 30% more for 6 s. In Briarback: Den Guard, your wolves take 30% less damage and taunt everything near them for 4 s. As a Wolf: Running Howl, you, your wolves and allied heroes within 12 m are Hastened and deal 20% more for 6 s.

bolt_turret.name: Bolt Turret
bolt_turret.desc: Build a Bolt Turret up to 8 m away. It shoots the nearest enemy within 10 m for 45% weapon damage and stands 45 s or until destroyed. One turret at rank 1, two at rank 2, three at rank 3 (building past the limit takes down the oldest).

shrapnel_mine.name: Shrapnel Mine
shrapnel_mine.desc: Bury a mine up to 8 m away (three at most). It arms after 1 s; the first enemy over it blasts everything within 3 m for 90% weapon damage and slows them.

field_repair.name: Field Repair
field_repair.desc: Repair every turret within 8 m for 35% of its health, and patch yourself for 10%.

grapnel.name: Grapnel
grapnel.desc: Fire a grapnel and pull yourself up to 8 m toward where you aim, clipping enemies where you land for 30% weapon damage.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.desc: For 8 s your turrets fire twice as fast and deal 50% more damage.
